businessOrCleanupStatus.qualification: Dynamic business and cleanup evidence is real and current-byte, but this review does not admit it as final implementation GO while S2-R2 and N1 remain unresolved.

findings.title: Password recovery verification now has one submit path
findings.disposition: The submitter has no custom verify callback; onFinish is the sole verify path. The fresh operations L2 captures POST /password-recovery/otp/verify and asserts the observed request count is exactly one before owner navigation.

findings.title: A stale data-scope selection still breaks GROUP to HEAD_COMPANY user aggregation
findings.finding: IA02 makes data scope conditional on the selected page's requiredDataNodeType; IA05 fixes the HEAD_COMPANY user page target and does not allow a scope selector. The shell nevertheless keeps one global selectedDataNode in session and always puts it into queryContext. WorkspaceUserPage sends that scopeRef to the HEAD_COMPANY endpoint even though the catalog says requiredDataNodeType=NONE. WorkspaceUserService only treats a GROUP assignment as the approved HEAD_COMPANY aggregate when the effective scope is null or equals the group id; a prior REGION/PROJECT/STORE scope therefore falls through to requireTaskPath(HEAD_COMPANY, staleId) and rejects the otherwise authorized page. The fresh L2 only proves a null-scope navigation, so it does not close this boundary.
findings.requiredRepair: Keep the target fixed and fail-closed, but make the server's GROUP plus HEAD_COMPANY branch independent of any stale client scope (the scope is not an input for a NONE page); add a focused owner test with a non-group visibleDataNode and a managed L2 path that first selects a scope-required page, then opens HEAD_COMPANY users. The frontend may omit the irrelevant scopeRef as an optimization, but must not be the authority.

findings.title: U11 write/readback denominator still excludes changed platform write surfaces
findings.finding: The U11 amendment requires every changed write surface to demonstrate control -> generated client request -> owner readback or subsequent GET -> rendered state. The package changed paths include platform administrator, workspace, role, account and extension write surfaces, but their governed specs stop after opening the owner detail or edit/status control: platform-admin-management.spec.ts, workspace-management.spec.ts, role-management.spec.ts, workspace-account-management.spec.ts and extension-field-management.spec.ts contain no request capture, response assertion or post-write owner readback. This is not a Redux-internal assertion request; it is the amendment's observable transport/readback bar. Operations store status and public recovery now provide examples, but they do not cover these changed platform surfaces.
findings.requiredRepair: For each changed platform write surface, add only the approved existing control interaction, generated request assertion, owner response/readback and rendered state assertion; if a surface is intentionally not mutated in this L2, narrow the amendment/package denominator explicitly rather than counting a detail-only proof as write coverage.
